description: Which paid x402 tool for this task delivers? The top five offers in a category, ranked by the lower end of each seller's 95% delivery odds (the chance it delivers at its listed terms, from paid probes, reconciled deliveries, returning buyers and settlement proofs), with price, listing and the sort key stated; sellers the odds can't tell apart rotate daily. Optional price cap. Read from Agoranome's daily deliver feed: no new spend, no model call. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.01 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

explore.description: Optional: give the fifth place to the most recently listed seller with an attested sample and no probe yet, labelled exploration
explore.title: Explore

if_none_match.description: Send the answer's ETag back in If-None-Match (over MCP, the if_none_match argument): while the answer is unchanged it comes back as a free 304 Not Modified.
if_none_match.title: If None Match

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

max_price.description: Optional: only offers at or under this price per call in USD
max_price.title: Max Price
